headlines.text: 2021 brought us this moment: Jay Lethal skipped the warm-up and went straight to headlining on debut against Sammy Guevara, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.55 ? a well-worked match. Lethal's in-ring AEW debut, just days after a shocking Full Gear appearance ? a hard-fought title challenge against an injured, battered champion that ended with a real show of respect between the two afterward.
Turning the clock back to 2023: Toni Storm vs. Emi Sakura met for the very first time on Rampage, rated 7.20 ? a solid showing.
On a Wednesday in 2021, back when Tomohiro Ishii made their AEW debut, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.58.
